title: Attackers Could Take Over Your Mac Through Screen Sharing Unless You Update Now - CNET
summary: You can turn off screen sharing or check who has access to your Mac’s screen in the Mac OS system settings under General, and then Sharing. A representative for Apple did not immediately return a request for comment.
